oS.text:
Changelog:
-Made a Debug feature rework. Players now have to press [0] once to get a Developer Mode prompt.
-Fixed a critical bug that prevented the Delta timing script from executing and causing major bugs.

-Added a scroller to the Debug Panel. Can be used with keys + and -.
-Added A Text engine with a debug panel, activate by pressing "0"
-Resolution Slider was removed, now it can be changed by the number keys [1-9]. Debug panel can be toggeled with "0"
-Added new custom functions in the GUI Layer
-Refined some variable names for readability
-Added features from /DEV Branch
-Added degauss effect after a scan is completed
-Added Delta time implimentation. The Project can now properly run in 60FPS mode on Turbowarp
-Changed INIT functionality and fixed thumbnail visual bugs
-Added Intro Animation and INIT function
-Changed Raycaster logic; it now has transparency capabilities
-Fixed frame drops with rendering engine
